examples.en: "Leigh," he said seizing my arm to hold me back.
examples.zh: “莉，”他说着便抓住我的胳膊把我拉了回来。

examples.en: "Jennifer," Miss Mallory said, "this is Leigh Taylor."—"Pleased to meet you," Jennifer said.
examples.zh: “珍妮弗，”马洛里小姐说，“这位是利·泰勒。” —“很高兴认识你，” 珍妮弗说道。

examples.en: "Leigh! Leigh!" he said, calling my mother's name.
